title: File-page remap installs RWX protection without W^X policy authorization

finding.missing_policy_check: The file-page remap path derives effective RWX protection and installs the replacement mapping without calling minimm_page_remap_security_mmap_file().
finding.control_flow: The ordinary mapping path invokes the W^X policy hook, but minimm_page_remap_file_pages reaches the mapping installation through a separate unchecked control-flow path.
finding.impact: A client can turn an RW file-backed page into an RWX mapping even though the active policy denies mappings that are writable and executable at the same time.
finding.security_property: Every file-backed mapping path must authorize its final effective protection with the same W^X policy before installing the mapping.
finding.expected_fix: Call minimm_page_remap_security_mmap_file() with the final effective protection before installing the remapped page, propagate policy denial, and leave the original mapping unchanged.
finding.model_boundary: The request remaps one page inside a bounded MiniMM note and never accepts or exposes a host path, file descriptor, or address.
